en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard with a panoramic view of a small town in a valley, showing fields in the foreground, several villagers (including one holding a large banner or cloth) and a cluster of houses and church spires backed by low hills. The lower part is blank for writing and printed with red German text referring to a sanatorium and the place name Bad Kreisch(a) near Dresden.
